newsitem.title: USA: Amgen stock drops amid threat from rival.
newsitem.headline: Amgen stock drops amid threat from rival.

text.p: Shares of Amgen Inc fell on Monday in a drop that some analysts linked to the threat of competition to its Epogen drug.
Cambridge, Mass.-based Transkaryotic Therapies Inc is developing a drug similar to Epogen, the Amgen drug widely used to boost the red blood cell count in kidney dialysis patients.
Amgen shares fell 3-7/8 Monday to 63 on trading of more than four million shares, compared with a daily average of about 2.6 million. Transkaryotic's stock rose 1-5/8 to 23-3/8.
